quote: we use top-10 topic words of each topic to calculate topic coherence and report the results of 3 topic coherence measures: C_A, C_P, and NPMI.
We evaluate the performance of proposed models ... using topic coherence measures.

We evaluate the performance of the proposed models and baselines using topic coherence measures. Topic coherence measures are metrics for quantifying the understandability of the extracted topics, which are shown highly correlated with human subjects.
